description: This file defines a PHP class named Cryptographer that provides encryption and decryption functionalities using AES and Rijndael algorithms. It manages cryptographic keys, encrypts plain text, and decrypts encrypted strings, encapsulating the cryptography logic for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: A class providing encryption and decryption methods using Rijndael and AES algorithms, with key management based on a provided secret key.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer with a secret key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using Rijndael cipher after setting key parameters, returns the encrypted data in uppercase hexadecimal.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted hexadecimal string back to plain text using AES cipher.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic key by XOR-ing the provided key characters with a null byte array, used internally for both encryption and decryption.
